query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, gather 'round, ye brave souls! 🏴‍☠️

Listen up, every last one of ye, for yer captain has words that'll set yer hearts ablaze!

**The seas before us hold secrets that landlubbers could only dream of!** Somewhere beneath the crashing waves and beyond the horizon lies a treasure so grand, so magnificent, that kings and queens have wept knowin' they'll never lay eyes upon it! But WE will, me hearties — AYE, WE WILL!

Every blister on yer hands, every storm we've weathered together, every sleepless night on watch — it's ALL been leadin' us HERE, to this very moment! The map is in our hands, the wind is at our backs, and DESTINY is callin' our names!

**Do ye think fortune favors the timid?** NAY! It favors the BOLD — the ones who dare to sail where others fear to go! And look around ye — are there any cowards on this ship?! I think NOT!

When we find that chest — and find it WE WILL — every man and woman among ye shall have their rightful share! Gold enough to buy yer own island! Jewels bright enough to blind the sun itself! A life of legend that'll be sung in every tavern from here to the ends of the earth!

**So sharpen yer swords, trust yer compass, and keep yer eyes sharp!** The treasure won't find itself, and the glory won't come to those who sit idle!

Now, WHO'S WITH ME?! ⚓

*Raises cutlass to the sky*

**ONWARDS, YE MIGHTY CREW — TO GLORY, TO GOLD, AND TO ADVENTURE!!!** 🗺️💰☠️
